bio: James served in the Pacific as a radio operator and came home to study engineering on the GI Bill. He designed camera shutters for most of his career and kept a workshop in the basement until the end.
funFacts: Said he still dreamed in Morse code decades after the war.
Designed camera shutters for most of his career.

military.note: Served on a destroyer escort; discharged 1946.

media.title: The Sodus Bay cottage, nearly finished, 1940.
